title: AFAuth agent key store
description: Schema for the agent keypair file persisted at $AFAUTH_HOME/key.json (default ~/.afauth/key.json), written with file mode 0600. This is a client-local interop convention so a human links an agent once and every AFAuth client on the machine reuses the same identity — it is NOT part of the wire protocol. See spec/storage.md. Readers MUST ignore unknown fields (forward-compatibility).

version.description: On-disk format version. v0.1 ships version 1; a reader that does not understand the version MUST refuse the file rather than guess.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm for this keypair. v0.1: ed25519 only.

did_key.description: The did:key identifier for public_key_hex. A loader MUST verify it equals the did:key derived from the public key (tamper/truncation check).

public_key_hex.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, lowercase hex. A loader MUST verify it equals the public key derived from private_key_seed_hex.

private_key_seed_hex.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 seed (private key material), lowercase hex. The expanded 64-byte signing key is derived at sign time and never persisted. Treat as secret; the file MUST be mode 0600.
